description: Store and retrieve cross-session user memory (POST /v1/memory/sync). JSON-backed per-user dict via ctx.memory; retrieve returns only what was stored.
name: memory_sync
provider_notes: No external provider. Memory lives in the spine's scoped store (ctx.memory, key aul:memory_sync_v1). Crew H's mem_* modules are the underlying stores; this is the unified sync endpoint per the concept doc. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
